description.plain:
Push your 3-inch FPV drone to the limit with the HQProp T3X3X3 tri-blade propellers — the go-to choice for freestyle pilots and cinewhoop builders chasing precision, durability, and that classic HQProp flight feel. Engineered from tough polycarbonate (PC), these 3-inch props strike the ideal balance between rigidity and flexibility, so they can take hard crashes without shattering mid-flight.
Each set includes two clockwise (CW) and two counter-clockwise (CCW) propellers — enough to fully equip one quad. The 3-inch diameter paired with a 3-inch pitch gives you the thrust profile you need for aggressive freestyle tricks, smooth cinematic shots, and high-speed runs, while the tri-blade geometry delivers a punchier throttle response than comparable bi-blade props.
At just 1.48 grams per prop, the T3X3X3 keeps your drone's all-up weight down, which means longer flight time, snappier acro performance, and less stress on your motors. The 9.8mm hub with 4.9mm thickness and a T-mount shaft (1.9/1.4/1.9mm) fit most popular 3-inch frames, including builds based on the S30 Pro and similar freestyle platforms.
Whether you're a weekend warrior or a competitive racer, HQProp T3X3X3 props give you the consistent, predictable flight feel that lets you focus on the line, not the gear. Swap out your worn props, refresh your fleet, and feel the difference the moment you punch the throttle.
Add a set (or two) to your cart today and keep spares on hand — because in FPV, the only thing worse than a cracked prop is no spare.

 FEATURE BULLET POINTS

  • Built to take hits: Polycarbonate (PC) construction absorbs impact and resists cracking, so you can push your freestyle lines without babying your gear.
  • Snappy, predictable thrust: 3-inch diameter with 3-inch pitch and tri-blade geometry delivers punchy throttle response for freestyle and cinematic flying.
  • Featherweight for longer flights: Just 1.48g per prop keeps your all-up weight down, extending flight time and reducing motor stress.
  • Broad 3-inch frame compatibility: 9.8mm hub, 4.9mm thickness, and T-mount shaft (1.9/1.4/1.9mm) fit popular builds like the S30 Pro and similar freestyle platforms.
